Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: FRONT source turnaround of the EXISTING M07 municipal crawler crane.
Input1 is the exact current source master. Use its small upper-right STOWED TRAVEL view as the equipment state; use large deployed view only to understand connections. Preserve this machine's identity and teal/ivory/red palette. It is a low self-propelled tracked municipal lifting machine, NOT a humanoid/robot animal.
Draw ONE straight FRONT orthographic-like full view, square 1024x1024 on clean white. Front of both tracks and cab toward viewer, upper carriage aligned with lower chassis, no 3/4 angle. Complete boom tip/cab/tracks/hook and margins, no extra views/text/insets. Same warm black ink outlines, solid cel shading and light service wear as source.
Exact equipment inventory: TWO graphite crawler track units with long teal side housings, low broad rotating central chassis, ONE offset operator CAB on VEHICLE RIGHT FRONT (front viewer LEFT), blue-teal multi-pane windshield, ivory angular cab face with red lower frame/bumper and teal roof/side. ONE large telescoping rectangular BOOM centered slightly to vehicle LEFT, mounted on rear central slewing assembly, LOWERED HORIZONTAL in travel cradle, lengthwise from rear past front cab. Its tip with real pulley/sheaves and hook lock is near front to viewer RIGHT of cab, NOT a second cabin or gun. Front projection naturally foreshortens the long boom; don't rotate machine to display whole length.
ONE red/graphite cable winch/reel on VEHICLE LEFT side of upper carriage (front viewer RIGHT), rear ivory counterweight with red corner blocks. FOUR articulated stabilizer outriggers total, two per side, fully FOLDED closely into side housings above tracks in TRAVEL mode. No deployed feet, no extra standing legs, no unsupported pads. Hook reeved through tip pulleys and LOCKED into front travel bracket with short taut cable, no dangling hook reaching ground. Retain ivory/teal boom faces, red border and small red-white warning stripes, steel silver hydraulic rods, black hoses. Source's functional shapes and component placement, no redesign or copied human head. Do not add firefighter water tanks, road wheels, weapons, logos or multiple booms.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: M12 Mirror Star electronic-countermeasure aircraft robot source-design PROPOSAL sheet.
Input1 is EXISTING M12 identity: purple/ivory slender mechanical robot, compact four-point DIAMOND optical head with ONE magenta lens in dark center, original prism equipment. Keep this distinct head identity, adult proportions and purple/ivory hierarchy.
Input2 is the already adopted M08 aviation-family BODY/COMPONENT organization used ONLY as a proposed shared engineering skeleton: canopy chest, boxed shoulder intakes, actual wing-root pivots and twin engine nacelle housings, continuous aircraft skin and full thighs/shins. Do NOT copy M08's V-horn head, color, rifle, decorative spiky fins. M08 itself is not being redesigned.
Input3 is ONLY project drawing finish: expressive ink, clean cel-shaded surfaces, controlled wear; do not copy its helmet, palette or service role.
Create a polished landscape 1536x1024 white source sheet. Left 60%: ONE complete adult full-body three-quarter front hero machine, long enough normal limbs matching input2's balanced proportion, feet and head fully visible, calm protective stance, no squat big-head or overly thin fashion body. Right upper: one HEAD closeup. Right middle: paired small closeups of SAME left-forearm prism device CLOSED / OPEN linked by hinge-motion arrow. Right lower: one compact AIRCRAFT-mode concept that visibly uses same wing roots, canopy, twin engines and folded sensor device. Minimal labels only "M12", "CLOSED", "OPEN", no logos.
Design: primary deep violet/plum aircraft skin with broad warm ivory panels and graphite articulated joints, restrained dark teal canopy glass and magenta optical accents. Keep existing diamond head as a compact machined four-sided sensor frame around one circular magenta iris, ivory beveled upper corners and purple lower corners; no face, no Gundam V crown or humanoid facemask, no huge sorcerer crystal. Tall enough head housing, not flattened. Reuse source2 aviation torso/hips/leg lengths and wing-root logic, reduce gratuitous pointy armor, add thin access seams and curved skin panels. Twin back wings and engine housings, graceful but not frail.
Distinctive FUNCTION: The prism is ONE physical left-forearm ECM/identification-flip module attached via a visible swivel and hinge base, not floating magic. CLOSED: compact diamond shell folded flat along outside left forearm. OPEN: its FOUR hinged triangular mirrored panels fan into a coherent diamond/dish around one central sensor/emitter; visible black support struts/cables connect every panel to forearm mount. No levitating extra shards. The right hand is free, no rifle/sword. Mirror faces reflect soft colored geometric bands, not spell effects. Small reversible identification plates on shoulder/forearm have coral on one side and teal on the reverse, visible flip hinge/detent, no franchise emblem. This is a machine able to misdirect enemy recognition and shield retreat, not an evil spell caster.
Aircraft inset: original electronic-warfare jet silhouette derived from input2 family, purple/ivory, paired intakes/engines and stable flight surfaces. Diamond head folds into compact dorsal sensor fairing, closed forearm prism fits alongside fuselage as sensor pod; no loose body parts, no cube floating over jet. Preserve recognizable shared component origins without pretending tested complete transformation. Rich clear source illustration, not generic 3D render, no photographic metal noise.
